mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate above 4.8% triggers negative 5-day S&P 500 returns as investor sentiment shifts to risk aversion during labor market stress.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE does not cross 4.8% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both increase >5% in 1 month
failure_condition: Returns not significantly positive despite simultaneous proxy increases (t-test p > 0.05) or proxies fail to meet threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0) in a late-cycle expansion predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 returns via reduced policy tightening pressures.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.0 or returns are negative despite the condition (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over 3 months predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through lower borrowing costs and improved equity valuations.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS do not decline sufficiently or returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 140,000 triggers negative 5-day S&P 500 returns as market anticipates recession risks.
failure_condition: Returns not significantly negative despite the trigger or PAYEMS does not cross threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in demand (GDPC1) and labor (PAYEMS) drives positive 20-day S&P 500 returns via expanded economic activity.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and PAYEMS both increase >5% in 1 month
failure_condition: Returns not significantly positive despite concurrent proxy increases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High supply (INDPRO > 120) in a recovery regime predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through sustained growth in production capacity.
failure_condition: Returns negative despite INDPRO exceeding 120 or the 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
